entries.jp: ――京　錦市場
entries.en: --Kyoto,\nNishiki Market

entries.jp: さっすが\n京の都は賑やかだなぁ！
entries.en: Whoa, Kyoto\nsure is lively!

entries.jp: 土佐とは違って\n町全体に活気があるぜよ
entries.en: Not like Tosa--\nthis whole town's\nbuzzin' with life!

entries.jp: なにせ京は流行の\n最先端を行く町
entries.en:
After all, Kyoto's
the town on the
cutting edge of
every trend.

entries.jp: 土佐の連中には\nわしの歌の良さは\n理解できんかったが
entries.en:
Folks back in
Tosa couldn't get
how great my
songs are, but...

entries.jp: 京の人らには受け入れ\nられるはずぜよ！
entries.en: ...the people of\nKyoto oughta take\nto 'em for sure!

entries.jp: なんせ　土佐では\nひどい目に遭った\nからな……
entries.en: Man, I sure had\na rough time of\nit in Tosa...

entries.jp: だが\n今日からは違う
entries.en: But from today\non, things are\ndifferent.

entries.jp: わしの歌を京に\nいや日の本いっぱいに\n轟かせるぜよ
entries.en:
I'm gonna make
my songs roar
across Kyoto--no,
all over Japan!

entries.jp: そのためにもまず\n大舞台（オーディション）\nの会場に行ってみんとな
entries.en:
And for that,
first I gotta go
check out the
audition hall.

entries.jp: しっかし　弥太郎のヤツ\n任せておくぜよ！\nとか言って
entries.en:
Jeez, that
Yataro... goes
"Leave it all to
me!" and then...

entries.jp: どこへ行きよったんだ
entries.en: ...where'd he\nrun off to?

entries.jp: わし一人では\n西も東もわからんぜよ
entries.en:
On my own, I
can't tell east
from west
around here.

entries.jp: 大舞台の会場と\nいうのはどっちへ\n行けばいいのかのう
entries.en:
Which way am I
s'posed to go
for this audition
hall, anyhow?

entries.jp: 大舞台会場
entries.en: Audition Hall

entries.jp: おう　ここじゃここじゃ！\nここが大舞台の会場じゃ！
entries.en:
Hey, this is it,
this is it! This
here's the
audition hall!

entries.jp: 頼もーう！
entries.en: Hellooo!\nAnybody home!?

entries.jp: \fnt1帰れ\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Go home.\fnt0

entries.jp: まだ何も言っちょらん！
entries.en: I ain't said\nnothin' yet!

entries.jp: その成り　その言葉\nどうせどこかの田舎から\nやってきたんだろう
entries.en:
Your looks, your
speech... You've
come from some
backwater, no
doubt.

entries.jp: ここは栄誉ある幕府の\n歌い手を決める場
entries.en:
This is where
the shogunate's
honored singers
are chosen.

entries.jp: 紹介状もない者を\nおいそれと入れる訳には\nいかぬ
entries.en:
I cannot simply
let in someone
without a letter
of introduction.

entries.jp: しょ　紹介状
entries.en: A-a letter of\nintroduction?

entries.jp: どこかの天歌師範なり\n藩主なりから紹介状を\nもらってくるんだな！
entries.en:
Go get a letter of
introduction from
some Heaven's
Song master or
domain lord!

entries.jp: そ　そんなこと言わずに\n入れて欲しいぜよ！
entries.en: A-aw, don't\nbe like that!\nLet me in!

entries.jp: そうじゃ！\nわしの歌をちょっとでも\n聴けば　わかるぜよ！
entries.en:
I know! Just
listen to my
song for a bit,
and you'll get it!

entries.jp: さあ　わしの歌を……
entries.en: Here goes,\nmy song...

entries.jp: 殴られた
entries.en: He got punched.

entries.jp: いってぇぇぇ！\n何をするんじゃ！
entries.en: Owwww! What\nwas that for!?

entries.jp: 紹介状がなければ\n審査は受けられぬ！\nそう申しただろう！
entries.en:
Without a letter
of introduction,
you may not be
judged! Did I
not say so!?

entries.jp: 第一　免状のない者が\n勝手に歌うは重罪ぞ！
entries.en: Besides, singing\nwithout a license\nis a grave crime!

entries.jp: じゅ　重罪
entries.en: A-a grave crime?

entries.jp: 話が違う！\nそれじゃ土佐と一緒だ！
entries.en:
That ain't what
I heard! Then
it's no different
from Tosa!

entries.jp: 何を言っておるか\nわからんが……\n決まりは決まりなのだ
entries.en:
I don't know what
you're talking
about... but rules
are rules.

entries.jp: ほら　さっさと帰れ！
entries.en: Now, go\nhome already!

entries.jp: もう一度歌う
entries.en: Sing again

entries.jp: 武士にくってかかる
entries.en: Argue with\nthe samurai

entries.jp: 大人しく諦める
entries.en: Give up quietly

entries.jp: そう言わんと\nちょっとだけでも\n聴いてみるぜよ！
entries.en: Aw, don't say\nthat! Just give\nit a little listen!

entries.jp: わしの歌の熱い思いを\nわかってほしいんじゃ！
entries.en: I want you to\nfeel the burnin'\nheart in my song!

entries.jp: さあ　行くぜよ……！
entries.en: Here goes...!

entries.jp: 例外は認められぬ\n早々に立ち去られよ！
entries.en: No exceptions.\nLeave at once!

entries.jp: ちゃんと聴きもせずに\n認めんとはなんじゃ！\n聴いてから判断するぜよ！
entries.en:
What d'you mean,
refusin' without
even listenin'
properly!? Listen
first, then decide!

entries.jp: 私は門番だ\nその役目にない
entries.en:
I am a
gatekeeper.
Judging isn't
my place.

entries.jp: 紹介状のあるものを通し\nそれ以外を通さぬのが仕事
entries.en:
My job is to let
in those with a
letter of
introduction,
and no one else.

entries.jp: お前も腰に刀差す立場なら\nわかるだろう
entries.en:
If you are one
who wears a
sword at his
hip, you should
understand.

entries.jp: そこを何とか\nしてくれんかのう
entries.en: Can't you do\nsomethin'\nfor me here?

entries.jp: 例外はない\n歌を審査して欲しくば\n紹介状を持って出直されよ
entries.en:
No exceptions.
If you want your
song judged,
come back with
a letter of
introduction.

entries.jp: そこまで言われたら\n大人しく引き下がるぜよ
entries.en: If you put it that\nway, I'll back\ndown quietly.

entries.jp: わかればよい
entries.en: Good. You\nunderstand.

entries.jp: 結局　龍馬は大舞台の\n会場からつまみ出されて\nしまったのだった……
entries.en:
In the end,
Ryoma got
thrown out of the
audition hall...

entries.jp: なんだ　なんだ\nわしの歌はここでも\nダメだっていうのか？
entries.en:
What, what?
My songs ain't
good enough
here either?

entries.jp: がっくりきたぜよ
entries.en: Man, that\nknocked the\nwind outta me...

entries.jp: ふぉっふぉっふぉ\nそうしょぼくれるな
entries.en: Ho ho ho! Don't\nlook so glum.

entries.jp: お前の歌\n捨てたもんじゃないぞ
entries.en: Your singing isn't\nhalf bad, lad.

entries.jp: 聴いてたんか\nいや　わしは歌って\nおらんが……
entries.en: You heard it?\nWait, no, I didn't\neven get to sing...

entries.jp: ワシくらいになると\n聴かんでも見ただけで\nわかるのよ
entries.en:
Someone of my
caliber needn't
hear a note,
lad. One look
tells me all.

entries.jp: そりゃすげえ！\nお前は歌の先生か\nなんかか？
entries.en:
Whoa, amazin'!
Are you a
singin' teacher
or somethin'?

entries.jp: ま　そんなようなもんじゃ\nワシは天狗……\nテンちゃんと呼ぶがいいぞ
entries.en:
Well, something
of the sort, hm. I
am the Tengu...
You may call me
Ten-chan, my boy.

entries.jp: なるほど！\nわしは坂本龍馬！
entries.en: Gotcha! I'm\nRyoma Sakamoto!

entries.jp: いずれは歌で\n日本一になる男ぜよ！
entries.en:
The man who's
gonna be number
one in Japan with
his songs one day!

entries.jp: 日本一と出たか\nこりゃ大きいな
entries.en: Number one in\nJapan, eh? That's\na big one, lad.

entries.jp: 土佐では天歌以外の歌は\n認められなかったが
entries.en:
Back in Tosa,
no songs but
Heaven's Song
were allowed...

entries.jp: 京ならきっとわしの\n新しい歌も受け入れられる\nそう思って来たんだ
entries.en:
...so I came here
thinkin' Kyoto
would surely take
to my new songs.

entries.jp: だが　勝手に歌ったら\n重罪だと言われて……
entries.en: But they told me\nsingin' on my own\nis a grave crime...

entries.jp: ふぉっふぉっふぉ\nあいつらは\n頭が固いからのう
entries.en: Ho ho ho! Those\nfellows are\nhard-headed, eh?

entries.jp: ワシはぜひ\nお前の新しい歌を\n聴いてみたいぞ
entries.en:
I'd dearly like
to hear those
new songs of
yours, my boy.

entries.jp: 本当か\nそんなら\nさっそく……
entries.en: Really? Well then,\nlet's get right to--

entries.jp: なんじゃ\n腹が減ってるのか\nよしよし
entries.en: Hm? Your belly's\ngrumbling, eh?\nThere, there.

entries.jp: まずは腹ごしらえだな\n腹が減っては\nいい歌は出来ぬ
entries.en:
First, let's fill
that belly. One
can't make a good
song on an empty
stomach, lad.

entries.jp: ワシが美味いメシを\n馳走してやろう
entries.en: Allow me to treat\nyou to a fine\nmeal, my boy.

entries.jp: 美味いメシ！\n京のメシは初めてじゃから\n楽しみぜよ！
entries.en:
A fine meal! It's
my first taste
of Kyoto grub--
I can't wait!

entries.jp: ふぉっふぉっふぉ\n美味すぎてほっぺたが\n落ちるかもしれんぞ
entries.en:
Ho ho ho! So
tasty your
cheeks might fall
right off, lad.

entries.jp: そりゃいかん\nしっかり\n手で持っておくぜよ！
entries.en:
Can't have
that! I'll hold
'em on tight
with my hands!

entries.jp: それじゃ\n行くとするかの\n店はすぐそこじゃ
entries.en:
Well then, shall
we be off? The
place is just
over yonder.

entries.jp: ひゃっほう！\nお前は　ホントに\nいいヤツぜよ～っ！
entries.en: Yahoo! You're\na real good\nguy, I tell ya~!

entries.jp: アルベルゴ\nディテラーダ
entries.en: Albergo di Terada

entries.jp: ほう……なんだか\n洒落た店だなぁ～
entries.en: Huh... What a\nfancy-lookin'\nplace~

entries.jp: おっ　きたきた\nこれだ　これ\nこれが美味いんじゃよ
entries.en:
Oh, here it
comes! This is
the one, my boy,
this right here.
Simply delicious.

entries.jp: はぁい　こちらが\nピッツァマルゲリータよ
entries.en: Heeere you\ngo! One pizza\nmargherita.

entries.jp: ぴっつぁまるげりーた？
entries.en: Peetsa\nmargareeta?

entries.jp: こいつを　ちょいとつまみ\nこうクルクルと丸めてな
entries.en:
You pinch this
here, eh, and roll
it up nice and
round like so...

entries.jp: 口を　あーんと開け\n一気に頬張るっ！
entries.en: ...then open wide,\naaah, and stuff it\nin all at once!

entries.jp: \fnt1うまい\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Delicious!\fnt0

entries.jp: ご　ごくっ！\nわしにも食わせるぜよ！
entries.en: *Gulp!* Lemme\nhave some too!

entries.jp: ここをつまんで\nクルクル丸めて……\nばくり！
entries.en: Pinch it here,\nroll it up round...\nand CHOMP!

entries.jp: \fnt1う　うまい～っっ！\nなんだ　これは\n未知のうまさぜよ！\fnt0
entries.en:
nt1D-deliciouuus! nt0
What IS this!?
It's a whole new
kinda tasty!

entries.jp: うふふ\n気に入ってもらえて\n嬉しいわぁ～
entries.en: Ufufu! I'm so\nglad you like it~

entries.jp: はもっはもっ……\nお　おかわり！\n五……いや十枚だ！
entries.en: *Munch munch*...\nS-seconds! Five...\nno, ten more!

entries.jp: お前\n遠慮というものを\n知らんのか
entries.en: Have you no\nsense of\nrestraint, lad?

entries.jp: まあいい\n女将　ワシにも\nあと五枚
entries.en:
Ah, never mind.
Landlady, five
more for me as
well.

entries.jp: はいは～い♪
entries.en: Coming right up~!

entries.jp:
女将が運んだピッツァを
龍馬とテンちゃんは
食って！　食って！
食いまくった！
entries.en:
Ryoma and
Ten-chan ate the
pizzas the
landlady
brought! They
ate! And ate! And
ate some more!

entries.jp: 初めての美味に龍馬は\n舌鼓を打ったのだった
entries.en:
Ryoma smacked
his lips at this
delicacy he had
never tasted
before.

entries.jp: はぁ～　食った食った\nもう腹いっぱいじゃ
entries.en: Haaah... I ate so\nmuch. I'm stuffed.

entries.jp: ワシもだ……
entries.en: As am I...

entries.jp: そう言えばテンちゃんは\n歌の先生ってことだが
entries.en:
Say, Ten-chan,
you said you're
a singin'
teacher, right?

entries.jp: まあ　正確にはな　\n才能のある歌い手を\n発掘して
entries.en:
Well, to be
precise, my boy,
my calling is to
dig up talented
singers...

entries.jp: 有名にするのが\nワシの役目だ！
entries.en: ...and make\nthem famous!

entries.jp: じゃあ　わしの歌を\nたくさんの人に聴いて\nもらえるのか？
entries.en:
So you mean a
whole lotta
people could
hear my songs?

entries.jp: うむ\nお前には才能がある\nいや　違うな
entries.en: Mm. You have\ntalent, lad... No,\nthat's not quite it.

entries.jp: お前の歌にワシは熱い\n熱情（パッション）を\n感じた！
entries.en: In your song,\nmy boy, I felt a\nburning passion!

entries.jp: おおお　熱情か！\nわしの歌にはいつも\n熱情を込めてるぜよ！
entries.en:
Ooh, passion,
huh! I always
pour my passion
into my songs!

entries.jp: 歌いたくてたまらん！\n聴いてほしいって\n熱情じゃ！
entries.en:
The passion of
"I'm dyin' to
sing!" and "I want
folks to hear!"

entries.jp: それでか！\n心を熱く揺さぶる\n魂の歌だった！
entries.en:
So that's it, eh!
A song of the
soul that set the
heart ablaze!

entries.jp: わしの歌\n日本中の人に\n聴いてもらえるのか？
entries.en: My songs... folks\nall over Japan\ncould hear 'em?

entries.jp: もちろんじゃ！\n夢はそれぐらい\nでっかくていい！
entries.en:
Of course! A
dream ought
to be at least
that big, lad!

entries.jp: お前なら出来る！\nワシが保証する！
entries.en: You can do it!\nI'll vouch for\nthat myself!

entries.jp: おおお\n俄然　やる気が\n出てきたぜよ！
entries.en: Ooh! Now I'm\nall fired up!

entries.jp: じゃが　そのためには\nまず雷舞（ライブ）の機材を\n揃えんといかんな
entries.en:
But to get there,
hm, first we'll
need to gather
gear for a live.

entries.jp: 雷舞の機材？
entries.en: Gear for a live?

entries.jp: うむ　お前の持っている\nギターの音や歌声を\nより大きく響かせるために
entries.en:
Mm. To make that
guitar and voice
of yours ring out
louder, lad...

entries.jp: アンプやらスピーカーの\n機材がいるのだ
entries.en: ...one needs\ngear like amps\nand speakers.

entries.jp: だが　大がかりな機材は\n幕府に独占されている
entries.en:
But the big
equipment is all
monopolized by
the shogunate.

entries.jp: だから　どうにかして\nそれを揃えねば……
entries.en: So somehow,\nwe'll have to get\nour hands on it...

entries.jp: むう　ここでも幕府が\n出てくるんか
entries.en:
Hmph, the
shogunate
shows up even
here, huh?

entries.jp: 京に来たら自由に歌えると\n思ってたのに\n難しいもんだなぁ
entries.en:
I figured I could
sing freely once
I got to Kyoto.
Things sure are
tough...

entries.jp: 何事にも\n準備というものが\n必要だろう
entries.en: Everything needs\nits preparations,\nmy boy.

entries.jp: じゃが機材がなくても\nわしにはこの喉がある！
entries.en: But even without\ngear, I got this\nthroat of mine!

entries.jp: 人に聴いてもらうなら\nまずはそれだけでも\n十分だろう！
entries.en:
If I want folks to
hear me, that
alone oughta be
plenty for a start!

entries.jp: わしはずっとそうやって\n歌ってきたんじゃ！
entries.en: That's how I've\nbeen singin'\nall along!

entries.jp: そうか\nそうだな　歌うのに\n確かに道具は関係ない
entries.en:
I see. Yes, quite
right. One
needn't any tools
to sing, eh?

entries.jp: おう！　そんで\nみんなが気に入って\nくれりゃあ……
entries.en:
Yeah! And then,
if everybody
takes a likin' to
it...

entries.jp: 幕府が認めて機材を\n譲ってくれるかもしれん
entries.en:
...the shogunate
might approve
of me and hand
over some gear!

entries.jp: そうだな\nお前の言うとおりだ
entries.en: Indeed, lad. It's\njust as you say.

entries.jp: そんで\n目指すはでっかく\n日本一の男ぜよ！
entries.en:
And then I'm
aimin' big--to be
the number one
man in Japan!

entries.jp: よう言った
entries.en: Well said, my boy.

entries.jp: そんでいつから\nやるんじゃ？\n今か？　今からだな？
entries.en: So when do we\nstart? Now?\nRight now, yeah?

entries.jp: まあ待て\nとりあえず店を出て\nじゃな……む？
entries.en:
Now, hold your
horses, lad. First,
we leave the
shop and... Hm?

entries.jp:
ごそごそと
袂を探っていた
テンちゃんが
首をかしげた
entries.en:
Ten-chan,
who had been
rummaging
through his
sleeves, tilted
his head.

entries.jp: 胸元の合わせを\nまさぐり\nぴょんぴょん跳ねる
entries.en:
He felt around
the front of his
robe and hopped
up and down.

entries.jp: しまった\n財布を忘れた
entries.en: Oh dear. I've\nforgotten\nmy wallet.

entries.jp: へっ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: すまん！\n後は任せたぞ！
entries.en: Sorry, lad!\nI'll leave the\nrest to you!

entries.jp: そう言うとテンちゃんは\n風のように去っていった
entries.en:
With that,
Ten-chan
was gone like
the wind.

entries.jp: へ？　へ？\nええええええ
entries.en: Huh? Huh?\nWhaaaaaat?

entries.jp: ま　まあ\n金がないんは\n仕方ないぜよ
entries.en: W-well, can't be\nhelped if he's\ngot no money.

entries.jp: テンちゃんとは\n同じ釜のぴっつぁを\n食うた仲だしな
entries.en:
Me and Ten-chan,
we ate pizza from
the same oven,
after all.

entries.jp: つまりはダチだ\n飯代くらい\nわしが持つか！
entries.en: So that makes\nus pals! I'll cover\nthe bill myself!

entries.jp: お～い！\nすまんが　勘定を\nお願いしたいんだが
entries.en: Heeey! Sorry,\nbut I'd like to\nsettle up!

entries.jp: は～い\n五両になるわ
entries.en: Coming~ That'll\nbe five ryo.

entries.jp: ぶっ！　ご　五両？\nそりゃちょっと高過ぎ\nじゃないか
entries.en: Pfft! F-five\nryo? Ain't that\na little steep?

entries.jp: ちょっとアンタ\nまさかお金\n持ってないの？
entries.en: Hey, you. Don't\ntell me you've\ngot no money?

entries.jp: そ そんなことないけど\nちょっと　待ってくれ
entries.en: I-it ain't that,\nbut... gimme a sec.

entries.jp: ひい　ふう\nみいの……\n十文……
entries.en: One, two, three...\nten mon...

entries.jp: それじゃあ　アンタが\n食べた分にもならないねぇ
entries.en: Well, that won't\neven cover what\nyou ate yourself.

entries.jp: へっ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: お金がないなら\nカラダで払って貰っても\nいいんだけどォ？
entries.en:
If you've got no
money, I wouldn't
mind if you paid
with your body~?

entries.jp: アンタ　ちょっと好みの\nタイプだし……
entries.en: You're kinda my\ntype, after all...

entries.jp: へっ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: それとも腰のものを\n置いていく？
entries.en: Or would you\nrather leave that\nthing at your hip?

entries.jp: い　いや　これは\nモジャモジャの先生から\n預かった大事な物だから
entries.en:
N-no, this
here's somethin'
precious the
Shaggy Sensei
left in my care.

entries.jp: う～～～ん　わかった！\nわしも男だ\n食った分は体で払うぜよ！
entries.en:
Hmmmmm...
All right! I'm a
man! I'll pay
for what I ate
with my body!

entries.jp: 薪割りでも水汲みでも\nどんと任せとけ\nなんでも言ってくれ
entries.en:
Choppin' wood,
haulin' water,
leave it all to
me! Just name it!

entries.jp: あら　そういう意味じゃ\nなかったんだけど……
entries.en: Oh my, that's\nnot what I\nmeant, though...

entries.jp: んふっ　そんなウブな\nところもカワイイ♪\nま　いいわ
entries.en:
Hehe, so
innocent.
That's cute
too~ Well, fine.

entries.jp: それじゃあ今日から\n薪割りに水汲みにお運びに\n出前頑張ってくれる？
entries.en:
Then from
today, will you
work hard
chopping wood,
hauling water,
serving tables
and running
deliveries?

entries.jp: もちろんじゃ！\n男に二言はないぜよ！
entries.en: You bet! A man\nnever goes back\non his word!

entries.jp: うふっ　いいお返事\nそれじゃ　これから\nよろしくね！
entries.en:
Hehe, good
answer. Well
then, I'm
counting on you!

entries.jp: そうそう\n名前を聞いてなかったわね\nアタシはお登勢よ
entries.en: Oh, right, I\nnever asked your\nname. I'm Otose.

entries.jp: わしは龍馬　坂本龍馬\n日本一の歌い手になる\n男ぜよ！
entries.en:
I'm Ryoma. Ryoma
Sakamoto! The
man who's gonna
be the greatest
singer in Japan!

entries.jp: 歌い手……？\n龍ちゃん　アンタ\n天歌を歌うの？
entries.en:
A singer...?
Ryo-chan, do
you sing
Heaven's Song?

entries.jp: いや　わしはわしの歌で\n日本一になると\n決めておる！
entries.en:
Nope, I've made
up my mind to
be number one
in Japan with
my own songs!

entries.jp: わしの歌……ね
entries.en: Your own\nsongs... huh.

entries.jp: どうかしたんか？
entries.en: Somethin' wrong?

entries.jp: ううん　なんでもないわ\n店で歌わないんなら\nいいわよ
entries.en:
No, it's nothing.
As long as you
don't sing in the
shop, it's fine.

entries.jp: み　店では歌ったら\nいかんのか
entries.en: I c-can't sing\nin the shop?

entries.jp: あったり前でしょ\nそんなのバレたら一発で\n営業停止よ
entries.en:
Well, obviously!
If anyone found
out, they'd shut
us down on the
spot.

entries.jp: そ　そうか……わかった\n店では歌わんようにする
entries.en: R-right... Got\nit. I won't sing\nin the shop.

entries.jp: はぁ……やっぱり京でも\n自由には歌えないんだな
entries.en: Sigh... So even\nin Kyoto, I can't\nsing freely.

entries.jp: 日本中どこでも\nそうよ\n常識でしょうに
entries.en:
It's the same
anywhere in
Japan. That's just
common sense.

entries.jp: でも\nいつかわしの歌が\n幕府に認められたら
entries.en:
But someday, if
the shogunate
recognizes my
songs...

entries.jp: お登勢やんにも\nわしの歌を聴いて\n欲しいぜよ！
entries.en: ...I'd love for\nyou to hear 'em\ntoo, Otose-yan!

entries.jp: んふっ　そうね\n楽しみにしてるわ～
entries.en: Tee hee,\nsure. I'll look\nforward to it~

entries.jp: それにしても……\n夢の大きい子ねぇ
entries.en: Still... what a\nbig dreamer\nthis boy is.

entries.jp: あたし　そう言うコ\nだぁい好き♪
entries.en: I just looove\nboys like that~

entries.jp: \fnt1うひゃあっ！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Whoaaah!\fnt0

entries.jp: まあ　色気のない悲鳴\n抱きつかれて\n嬉しくないの？
entries.en:
My, what an
unsexy scream.
Aren't you happy
to get a hug?

entries.jp: う……うぐ\nい　息が……できん\n……ぜよ
entries.en: Ngh... c-can't...\nbreathe... I\ntell ya...

entries.jp: んふふ　いい抱き心地\nこれからいっぱい\n仲良くしましょうね～
entries.en:
Tee hee~
You're so nice
to hug. Let's
get real close
from now on~

entries.jp: くぅ……
entries.en: Hnngh...

entries.jp: ちょっと　なに倒れて\n……えっ　息してない\nしっかりしてぇぇぇっ
entries.en:
Hey, why are
you falling...
Wait, you're not
breathing! Hang
in theeere!

entries.jp: こうして　龍馬の\n京での生活が始まった
entries.en: And so began\nRyoma's life\nin Kyoto.

entries.jp: 龍ちゃん\nこれ　三番卓に\nお願いね
entries.en: Ryo-chan, take\nthis to table\nthree, please.

entries.jp: わかったぜよ！
entries.en: You got it!

entries.jp: それが終わったら出前を\nお願いするわね
entries.en:
When you're
done with that,
I'd like you to
run a delivery.

entries.jp: それが終わったら薪割りと\n水汲みと　それから……
entries.en:
And when that's
done, chop wood,
haul water, and
then...

entries.jp: おう　まかせとけ！\n出前に行ってくるぜよ！
entries.en: Sure, leave it to\nme! I'm off on\nthat delivery!

entries.jp: はぁ～\n失敗したぜよ～
entries.en: Haaah... I\nreally blew it...

entries.jp: 配達先を聞かずに\n出前に飛び出した\nわしが悪い
entries.en:
My fault for
runnin' off on a
delivery without
askin' where it
was goin'.

entries.jp: 皿を割るのも\nわしの不注意
entries.en: Breakin' the\nplates was my\ncarelessness too.

entries.jp: ちゃんと出来た仕事は\n薪割りだけ……
entries.en: The only job I\ndid right was\nchoppin' wood...

entries.jp: お登勢やんが怒るのも\n仕方ないな……
entries.en: No wonder\nOtose-yan's\nmad at me...

entries.jp: やっぱりわしは\n歌しかないぜよ
entries.en: I guess singin'\nreally is all I got.

entries.jp: せっかく京に来たんじゃ\nやっぱ　どかーんと派手に\n歌わんといかんぜよ
entries.en:
I came all the
way to Kyoto. I
gotta sing big
and flashy,
with a BOOM!

entries.jp: こうなったら一人でも\nばーんと歌っちゃるか！
entries.en:
Fine, then! I'll
belt one out with
a BANG, even all
by myself!

entries.jp: なーに一人で歌うんは\n土佐で慣れてる！
entries.en: Heh, singin' solo's\nnothin' new. I got\nused to it in Tosa!

entries.jp: うおおおおおおおおおお！
entries.en: Wooooooaaah!
